Compare moisture removal, drainage and room conditions

Pints per day and bucket size are different

Moisture-removal capacity describes a test rate; the tank size determines how often you empty collected water. ENERGY STAR notes that changed test temperatures can make older and newer capacity figures difficult to compare directly. Check the stated test basis, operating-temperature range and your room conditions rather than choosing by square-foot coverage alone. ENERGY STAR capacity guidance.

Plan where the water will go

For continuous drainage, check whether the unit relies on a gravity hose or has a pump, and what hose is included. A pump claim needs its lift-height limit checked. For a bedroom or office, compare noise and fan settings as well as the humidity controls. A dehumidifier can manage moisture; it does not repair a leak or establish the cause of damp.
